title: Error when compiling with .gdbuild generated by Engine Compilation Configuration
body:
### Tested versions

branch 4.6 stable, godot v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439]

### System information

Windows 11 - Compatibility - v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439]

### Issue description

Fail to compile using gdbuild generated on project with 3D and 2D nodes.

**Error message:**
`definition of type 'Mutex' conflicts with type alias of the same name`

Compiling without `build_profile=template.gdbuild` worked fine.

### Steps to reproduce

Download project attached in MRP and extract it.
Open Godot 4.6 stable and open the project we just extracted.
Generate .gdbuild using Engine Compilation Configuration using Detect from Project feature or use `template.gdbuild` directly (it's generated by using Detect from Project without any alteration).

The MRP project contain zero script. Just a scene.

On Godot's source code directory go to branch 4.6 then copy template.gdbuild there.
In Godot's source directory run `scons platform=web build_profile=template.gdbuild`
The compilation process will fail.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[playable-empty-3d.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25572158/playable-empty-3d.zip)
